articles.summary:
### Summary

The TinaCMS admin builds its preview `<iframe src>` from the `/~/*` hash-router splat without checking that the value stays same-origin. A fragment with a doubled slash (`#/~//attacker.example/p`) becomes the protocol-relative URL `//attacker.example/p`, so the admin frames an external site.
